component.name: Roue
component.summary: Drop a file, get the file you wanted

description.p: Roue converts files by dropping them on preset tiles. Press a hotkey, drop a file, done. No dialogs, no editors, no uploads.

ul.li: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC to JPG, resize, compress, remove location and camera metadata
Video: MP4, GIF, WebM, under 10 MB or 25 MB for chat and email, mute
Audio: MP3, Opus, WAV, FLAC, even out loudness, extract the sound of a video
Documents: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Markdown to PDF, compress PDF, PDF pages to images or text
The drop panel, opened with a hotkey (Super+Shift+D by default), or by Shift-dragging any file on X11
"Convert to…" in the right-click menu of Files

description.p: Results are saved next to the originals and never overwrite anything. Everything runs on your computer with FFmpeg, libvips, Ghostscript, Pandoc and LibreOffice. Add your own presets as small YAML files.
First release: drop panel, Files menu, command line and 27 built-in presets.
